description: Google (official Vertex AI / Gemini API) — gemini-flash-lite-latest explores on flash, gemini-3.8-flash (2026-09-02) carries standard orchestration and vision, gemini-3.1-pro-preview codes on pro and judges on max as the strongest pro-line model under the $3/$15 red line (gemini-3-pro-preview it replaces was dropped from the catalog; 2.5-generation picks are superseded).
